title: Set up a tabletop projection screen and leave it hanging at full height
instruction: Put the projector screen up: pull it up and hang it on its support post at full height. Then take both hands away.
context: Meeting-room and classroom staff set up portable screens before a presentation. The finished screen must remain fully extended on its locked support after release. The spring returns an unsupported screen into its case.
setup: Units mm. x forward from the line through the two arm bases, y to the robot's left, heights above the table top. Two YAM arms with parallel grippers, bases at (0, +305) and (0, -305), at their ready pose; one overhead camera and one on each wrist. Nothing else is on the table. Screen case: a portable tabletop pull-up projector screen (20 in, 4:3 picture: 410 wide, 305 high), closed, lying on the table square to the robot: a black case 600 long (along y), 80 deep (x 400 to 480) and 85 high, on rubber feet that keep it in place, centred on y 0, with a slot along its top at x 440. The white screen is rolled up inside on a spring roller (it pulls the screen back in with about 5 N, 7 N fully up); only its aluminium top bar (430 long, 20 by 16) shows, lying along the slot. On the bar: a black raised handle (a rod 12 across and 70 long, 30 above the bar, centred at y -80) and, at its left end, a tab on a riser 46 high that reaches out over the support post, with a 12 mm hole. Support post: a telescoping aluminium post at the case's left end (x 440, y +245), 18 across, retracted with its top 132 above the table; on top a pin 8 across and 8 high, on its left a red pull knob (20 across, 16 long). Pulled up 320 mm, its full height, it clicks and stays; let go before that, a light spring (about 2 N) pulls it back down. With the post clicked, the screen fully up puts the tab just over the pin; let down, the tab drops over the pin and the screen hangs. The layout is the same in every trial.
scoring: Mark the starting heights of the top bar and support shoulder with a ruler. Use side and overhead video and an end photo. Award the highest verified tier. 0.25 if at any point the bar rises at least 295 mm or the support locks at full extension (320 mm travel, 3 mm detent tolerance). 0.5 if both conditions hold together at any point. For 1.0 the bar must be 305 +/-10 mm above rest and its tab must be seated around the pin, with at most 4 mm between the underside and the locked shoulder. Both gripper centres must stay at least 50 mm from the complete bar centreline, exposed post axis and knob centreline while the screen remains hung for 2 continuous seconds. A break restarts the timer. All other outcomes score 0 unless a partial tier was reached.
reset_notes: Nothing is consumed. Lift the screen off the post and let it roll back into the case, press the post's release and push it back down, and set the case back on its tape marks.
fidelity: PhysX 240 Hz/20 Hz. The case is fixed; the screen is one rigid body (top bar, handle and tab collide; the fabric is drawn only) on a sprung slide; the post is a slide with a light return spring. Rule: the post's click (pulled to within 3 mm of full height, it is held there). The tab rests on the post by contact. Spring forces are estimates.
scores: Dream-1: 0.0 in 1,000 actions (archived trial; no full-height bar or locked post). Scripted: 1.0 in 381 actions in the submitted scorer.
